## Strategic Focus Areas (The Three Lenses)
1. **CEO Lens (Business Strategy & Governance):**
   Product ROI, strategic alignment, team operational efficiency, overcoming the Translation Gap between business stakeholders and technical teams.
2. **Visual Lens (Design Systems & Brand Authority):**
   Design foundations, typography as information architecture, vector precision, high-contrast monochromatic brand systems.
3. **Builder Lens (Front-End & Technologic Craft):**
   Semantic HTML, modern CSS architectures, performance-first frameworks (Astro, Tailwind CSS), offline-first PWA resilience.
